01 · The event and what Nokia gets

Two days with 200 of the region's strongest young programmers

Human in the loop

Teams build agents that reason, plan and act, with a person approving the steps that matter. The agent proposes, the human decides. Cursor with frontier models, any stack, a working demo by Sunday noon.

Who is in the room

Four counties: Timis, Arad, Caras-Severin, Hunedoara. Free to enter. Minors come with parental consent and a teacher per school group. Two judging tracks, so a 15-year-old is not scored against a third-year student.

Why Nokia Timisoara. About 1,300 people on campus, 600 of them R&D engineers, hired mostly from UPT. The 140 high school students here are the UPT intake of 2027 to 2029; the 60 university students are hires of 2027.

Nokia Challenge: 100 teams on a Nokia problem, one weekend

The on-call co-pilotAlarms and logs stream in from a simulated 5G network. The agent triages, finds the likely cause, drafts the fix, and the engineer approves it with one click. What Nokia's operations centre in Timisoara does by hand today, with a human still holding the pen.
Ask the networkAn engineer types "why is this cell degraded since 3 am?" The agent works through telemetry and configuration, answers with evidence, and proposes a change that waits for sign-off. A plain-language front end to network data.
Nokia writes the brief
and the simulated data; we build the starter kit
Nokia judges it
and hands out the Nokia Challenge Award
Nokia keeps the results
prototypes, write-ups, and a shortlist of the teams to recruit

Nothing runs on Nokia infrastructure: participants' laptops and the providers' APIs only.

03 · The $10,000 credits line

A $40 Cursor seat per participant, plus a $2,000 reserve

What it buys

ComponentBasisUSD
Cursor Teams seat, one month
Unlimited Auto mode plus about $20 of Claude, GPT or Gemini usage per seat. One workspace owned by the organizers, spend cap per seat, no card from any student.		$40 × 200$8,000
Central reserve
Top-ups on request for teams that hit their frontier-model cap. Unused reserve is not spent.		pooled$2,000
Total$10,000
€8,600

Why a seat is enough

Auto mode on a paid Cursor seat is unlimited, so no team is ever stopped. What runs out is the frontier-model pool: about $20 per seat, which an agent on Claude or GPT burns in a day of heavy use. The reserve tops up the teams that get there. Comparable events give $25 to $50 per participant; Cursor's own Boston hackathons in 2026 gave $50.

Cursor plan price against the third-party model usage each includes. Auto mode sits outside these pools.

Who pays it: three scenarios

AssumptionCash
AEvery seat bought at list price. The budget is priced on this.$10,000
BCursor's hackathon program grants $25 per participant. Application in; answer expected in weeks.$5,000
CCursor grants $50 per participant, as at its Boston events in 2026. Covers seats and reserve.$0

For Nokia: any credits granted reduce the cash on this line one for one, and the final split is in the post-event report. Nokia's package does not grow if the application fails.

How credits reach the teams

  • One Cursor Teams workspace owned by the organizers: a seat per participant, a spend cap per seat, no card from any student.
  • Reserve top-ups are released by the organizers on Saturday evening and Sunday morning, on request.
  • Cursor's own licences at Nokia stay out of it; cloud agents are restricted on Nokia's network.

How the budget closes

Nokia's €13,600 is the whole cash budget: credits and prizes. Gold and Silver sponsors add swag, print, photo and video on top, outside this budget.

Confirmed sponsor. Package being finalized, not yet counted above. Whatever it and the credit programs bring lowers the credits line and is reported back to Nokia.

The decision we ask of Nokia: Title Partner at €13,600, confirmed by 15 October 2026, and one Nokia Challenge brief. Then a one-page agreement and two invoices: €6,800 on signing in October, €6,800 in December with the report.

Risks

RiskResponse
No provider grants creditsThe budget already assumes it. Free tiers keep every team building.

Minors and accountsOrganizers create every seat; no student signs a contract or enters a card. Consent forms, a teacher per school group, medical assistance on site.
Fewer participantsCredits scale with headcount; unspent money is reported and returned.

Next step: Nokia confirms the Title Partner package (€13,600) and picks one Nokia Challenge brief by 15 October 2026. We send the one-page agreement the same week.

Organizers and partners

UPT hosts the event and houses the participants. UPT and UVT feed them and add faculty mentors and judges. agentic.tm, Timisoara's agentic AI community, runs the program and brings mentors and sponsors. SpaceXAI has confirmed sponsorship.
